d_preserved_statement: The child's D is unchanged from game_spec/game_translations: read the sticky comparison bar (today's priority audience + 3 scenario facts, always visible, no open/close needed), open and read all 3 plan cards (src/q1/PromoGame.tsx PLAN_INFO — exact confirmed copy from game_translations_v18/v19's adopted t5-compare-candidate-plans.C_interaction), judge which plan is valid given today's audience+scenario (a plan's weakening condition is only ever implied through the card text and the disclosed scenario facts, never shown as a number or ranking), select one, and confirm once (confirmButton is disabled until all 3 cards are opened and a plan is selected; once confirmed the select phase is gone from the render tree — no re-toggle, no brute force). src/q1/reachMixLogic.ts's bestPlanSet/sessionWin ports factory/projects/legacy-reach-mix/design/design-sim.mjs's planFit/bestPlanSet/sessionWin logic verbatim (same PLANS, same planIsWeakenedThisSession rules, same multi-answer acceptance via bestPlanSet returning every tied plan) — verified by factory/harness/gameplay-qa-reach-mix.mjs reproducing design-sim.mjs's exact 20/20 checks and numeric results (legitimate_reasoning=1, independent_strategy_matches_internal_oracle=1, multi_answer_session_rate=0.1452, etc.) against the shipped module, not just the design-stage script.
revision_note: v1: implements t5-compare-candidate-plans per game_spec_v1.json. Also updated src/data/content/townEvent.ts's promo-event mission/discoveryEcho/seeds text, which still described the OLD legacy mechanic ('組み合わせよう' / combination-building) — now describes the adopted 'compare 3 plans' D. Fixed a real CSS bug found during manual QA: the shared .app-frame shell's overflow-x:hidden implicitly computes overflow-y to 'auto' per the CSS overflow spec, but .app-frame never actually scrolls itself (min-height:100dvh grows with content, so the page/body scrolls instead) — this silently breaks `position: sticky` (it was never used elsewhere in this codebase). Used `position: fixed` for the comparison bar instead (no ancestor sets a transform/filter, so its containing block is the viewport), with a useLayoutEffect-measured spacer div to reserve the bar's height in normal flow. Verified in the browser at 375px: the bar now genuinely stays pinned to the top of the viewport while the 3 plan cards scroll underneath.
